summary.text:
## Primary Request and Intent
- Test upstream dsh `0.1.2-alpha.5` locally via "Testing Approach 1" (Dev/Test 1: source-level 4999 instance, upstream checkout + embedded dashr) — user confirmed AGENTS.md holds the repo testing convention. Completed successfully.
- Turn alpha.5 adaptation into the next plugin dev phase via OpenSpec: 4 changes (Model Failover P1, loopback auth P2, mobile responsiveness P3, iKernel provisioning P4).
- iKernel provisioning rulings (user, verbatim intent): install by default "不要再 ask for approval"; every failure "只给出提示信息，但不会产生阻断性影响" (fail-open); check at daemon spin-up — "绝对不要等到 agent 真正发起运行时了才去检查"; kernel must be exclusive (own venv in web profile, pinned tested versions, never depend on user's global Python).
- User corrections: venv concurrency "worry" was a fabricated hazard — install is one-time, runtime check is idempotent pass; NO locks/atomic-publication/concurrency clauses (removed from spec).
- Defer the two user-personal Web UI patches (loopback auth, mobile responsive + swipe velocity判定) out of this wave to `openspec/deferred/` — user has new ideas, will do together in a later change.
- After GUI confirmation (“Settings Failover 有了”)： close the failover change, make one local commit with tag `v0.2.1e` (local only, no push).

## Key Technical Concepts
- Dev/Test 1: upstream checkout `~/workspaces/dashr/upstream/deepseek-harness` at tag `dsh-v0.1.2-alpha.5` (detached db6bdc3576), pnpm workspace, dashr copy at `packages/better-dsh/better-dsh/`, `DSH_HOME=~workspace/.dsh-test`, port 4999.
- Local harness patches (3): `tsdown.client.ts` REPOSITORY_ROOT derivation; `pnpm-workspace.yaml` storeDir redirect + `verifyDepsBeforeRun:false` + allowBuilds `zeromq: true` + `'@pgmi-builds/better-dsh': true`; root package.json `unrun` devDep.
- rsync loop pitfall: stale `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` peerDep returns from canonical every rsync — must re-delete in copy package.json (workspace lacks the package, npm has no matching version → `ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION`).
- Kernel provisioning ladder: postinstall (accelerator, zero-interaction) → daemon spin-up async `resolveKernelEnv` in `apply()` (primary) → first-use lazy (fallback); all fail-open, idempotent; pinned ipykernel 7.3.0 / dill 0.4.1 / CPython 3.11 (uv) with `python3 -m venv` fallback (3.14.4 verified compatible); `UV_CACHE_DIR`/`UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR` redirected to `<pkg>/.uv-cache`.
- Nested sandbox root cause: daemon launched from sandboxed bash → its bwrap functional probe fails `No permissions to create a new namespace` → `SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE`. Fix: `systemd-run --user` (transient unit `dsh-4999-test`, outside sandbox, logs to `.scratch/dsh-4999.log`); sandbox内 user bus unreachable → single-command `danger-full-access` escalation.
- Native settings-row registration: client bundle does `ctx.slots.inject('settings.general.item', register)` (slot spec `{kind:'list',scope:'root'}`); GeneralSection renders slot entries, data via `remote.settings`; NO pure server-side row face exists — FailoverRow is the native path (isomorphic to locale `LanguageRow` / ui-chat `TranscriptViewRow`).
- Client bundle delivery: `tsx scripts/build-client.ts` produces `lib/client/index.js` (closure-factory `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({...})`); `dsh.client` package.json declaration (`platform:"web"`, 4 inject rows); served at `/plugins/??@pgmi-builds/better-dsh/client.js&rev=…`; `npm run build-client` dies in the monorepo copy (exit 236) from npm's own pre-script workspace enumeration hitting `vendor/CLAUDE.md` (ENOTDIR).
- OpenSpec: spec-driven schema, zh artifacts/English SHALL; `openspec archive <change-name> -y` (NOT `--change`); change dirs `openspec/changes/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>/`; `openspec/deferred/` convention for parked changes.
- Sandbox bash: each call = fresh tmpfs `/tmp` (write-tool /tmp invisible to bash); cross-call temp files must live in workspace. Pipes swallow exit codes — use `set -o pipefail` / `${PIPESTATUS[0]}`.

## Files and Code
- `AGENTS.md` — one-stop contract; updated: harness now alpha.5, stash/pop patch replay, peerDep+zeromq pitfalls, systemd-run launch convention + nesting warning, rsync excludes +`.uv-cache`, deployment norm "user, just another user" (registry-only prod installs), kernel/client ✅ entries.
- `dashr/src/kernel-env.ts` — pins `IPYKERNEL_VERSION='7.3.0'`/`DILL_VERSION='0.4.1'`; exported pure builders `uvToolEnv/uvVenvArgs/venvFallbackArgs/uvInstallArgs/pipInstallArgs`; `createVenv`/`installDeps(python, venvDir)` inject env + mkdir `.uv-cache`.
- `dashr/src/index.ts` — `apply()` spin-up hook: fire-and-forget `resolveKernelEnv({python, venvDir: kernelEnvDir, pythonVersion, autoInstall ?? true, log})` with `.catch` → `logger.error`; import added.
- `dashr/scripts/kernel-provision.mjs` — postinstall + `kernel:venv` dual entry; fail-open (missing lib → skip exit 0; error → warn + remedies exit 0).
- `dashr/package.json` — version `0.2.1-e`; scripts `"kernel:venv"`/`"postinstall"` both → `node scripts/kernel-provision.mjs`; files += `scripts/kernel-provision.mjs`.
- `dashr/tsdown.config.ts` — entry += `src/kernel-env.ts` (lib/kernel-env.js, node-builtins only).
- `dashr/test/kernel-env.spec.ts` — 3 tests (pins, cache redirect, fallback args); suite total 403.
- `docs/50_test-reports/v0.2.1e-P1-实测报告.md` — runtime first-person report + my §5 phase-owner backfill (C2/O-1 sandbox closure, C1–C5 disposition, §5.5 Phase 2 closure).
- `docs/50_test-reports/kernel-provisioning.md` — one-page provisioning doc.
- `.agents/skills/upstream-alignment/SKILL.md` — S0–S8 alignment workflow; S6 systemd-run form; S7 client-bundle smoke (boot graph grep + URL byte-compare). Note: `.agents` is git-ignored (local-only).
- `openspec/specs/model-failover/spec.md` — absorbed via archive (+1 requirement).
- Git: commit `3f9221f` (90 files, +1320/−21, docs reorg as 100% renames), annotated tag `v0.2.1e`, NOT pushed; `.gitignore` += `.dsh-acp/`.

## Errors and Fixes
- `ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` → delete stale peerDep + peerDependenciesMeta in copy package.json after every rsync.
- `[ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS] zeromq@6.6.0` (placeholder `set this to true or false` = hard error) → allowBuilds `zeromq: true`.
- package.json edit dropped a trailing comma → broken JSON → tsc flooded TS1287/TS1295 (lost `"type":"module"`); fixed comma; lesson: validate JSON after edits.
- `SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE` on 4999 → nested-sandbox root cause; fixed via systemd-run relaunch (escalated once with danger-full-access after user-bus denial).
- `npm run build-client` in copy → `ENOTDIR vendor/CLAUDE.md/package.json`, exit 236 (npm pre-script workspace enumeration, tsx never started) → run `tsx scripts/build-client.ts` directly (33ms, green).
- Sandbox /tmp per-call tmpfs broke cross-call file reuse (trace script, cookie jars) → keep temp files in workspace (`.scratch/`).
- OpenSpec edit anchors go stale after edits → batch rejected atomically; re-read for fresh anchors. `openspec archive --change` invalid → positional name.
- User feedback (corrections): fabricated concurrency hazard removed entirely from spec/design/tasks; "找隐患不能替代推理" lesson recorded.

## Pending Jobs
- kernel-provisioning change task 5.2 remainder: prod install-path verification at release time (pnpm add exact version → daemon log `kernel ready` → REPL first cell instant).
- Deferred changes in `openspec/deferred/` (loopback-provider-directory, mobile-responsive-sidebar incl. swipe velocity spec) — awaiting user's new ideas for a future combined change.
- v0.2.1e-P1 report收口池： C1 (line magic transform vs document-unsupported + regression), C3 (kernel interpreter/cwd dual-location doc), C4 (eval boundary statement → README security/ADR).
- Next upstream alignment rounds: follow `.agents/skills/upstream-alignment` workflow.

## Current Work
- Completed the user's final request: closed `model-failover-settings-surface` (9/9, tasks annotated: 3.1 user GUI confirmed, 3.2 via failover.spec.ts 8 cases, 3.3 403/403 + tsc 0 errors, 4.1 written back), archived it via OpenSpec (spec absorbed), appended report §5.5, made local commit `3f9221f` + annotated tag `v0.2.1e` (`git describe` = v0.2.1e), memory flushed. No push (local only, per instruction).
- 4999 test instance still running as systemd user unit `dsh-4999-test` (v0.2.1-e build with client bundle); latest token `Bdddk8xXw7w76KWpYYvVYW01dGMtarJtF_GdHmyiRwY` (from `.scratch/dsh-4999.log`).

## Next Step
- (none) — wave v0.2.1e is fully closed; awaiting user direction (publish decision, deferred patches with new ideas, or收口池 items).

## Critical Context
- Prod (3080, npm alpha.3 + better-dsh 0.2.1-d) untouched throughout; prod deploy of v0.2.1e not requested. Release deployment rule: exact-version pnpm add (supply-chain age gate), never `@latest`.
- 4999 daemon must never be launched from sandboxed bash (breaks bwrap probe); always `systemd-run --user` per AGENTS.md.
- `.dsh-test` profile is shared with another agent's dsh ACP test (isolated partitions, shared profile — benign, explained mixed v4/v5 projcache writes).
- User communication style: terse commands, expects action not questions, harsh corrections when the model fabricates concerns — respond with evidence and precise reasoning, concede valid points immediately.
- OpenSpec artifacts in zh with English structural headings/SHALL; AGENTS.md is the authoritative contract — update it when conventions change.
